shop.name: Svarog Visiting-Rig Service
shop.directorySummary: Professional rig servicing, repairs and equipment installation.

copy.profileBlurb: The visiting-rig workbench at Svarog Shipyard faces racks of standard fittings and workshop gauges. A fitter sets aside a production drawing to look over your rig while the clerk prepares an itemized order.
copy.levelBlurb: Professional servicing, standard repairs, replacement parts and equipment installation
copy.diagnosisBlurb: “We’ll check the rig against its own specifications and list the repairs and exchanges this workshop can undertake.”
copy.serviceBlurb: “Select the systems. We’ll work through the service points, set the clearances and test the adjustments.”
copy.repairsBlurb: “The estimate is for the work on this rig. We’ll verify the selected assembly’s fit and grade before it leaves the parts rack.”

shop.name: Rochefort Precision Service
shop.directorySummary: Professional rig servicing, repairs and equipment installation.

copy.profileBlurb: At Rochefort, the workshop counter displays a clear labor schedule beside samples of standard fittings. Behind it, a technician reviews a completed job sheet with a colleague before calling you forward.
copy.levelBlurb: Professional servicing, standard repairs, replacement parts and equipment installation
copy.diagnosisBlurb: “We’ll inspect the rig and give you an itemized finding. You can choose the work once you’ve seen the estimate.”
copy.serviceBlurb: “Select the systems and we’ll book their service checks, adjustments and final tests. The estimate includes the time the rig will be here.”
copy.repairsBlurb: “The work order identifies the repair or fitted replacement. We’ll record the parts used and check the result before release.”
